summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in run_async's try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src. Full suite (excluding tests/cli, tests/devtools, tests/snapshot_tests, which can't be collected because click and aiohttp are missing) shows 68 failures, mostly from pytest-asyncio not being active in the venv (async tests and fixtures not run). test_features::test_textual_env_var also fails and was not investigated; failures were not compared against unmodified code. Nothing committed. The venv's textual is an editable install pointing at base/src, so tests were run with PYTHONPATH=src.
